description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's 'read-tree -m -u' functionality, including various scenarios such as two-way and three-way merges, handling ignored files, symlinks, and directory/file conflicts.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with setup and assertions.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_succeed
methods.description: Runs 'read_tree -m -u' command and expects it to succeed; captures output and error.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_fail
methods.description: Runs 'read_tree -m -u' command and expects it to fail.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Provides a cleanup command to run after tests.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Simulates a timestamp increment for test purposes.
